chapters.title: Chapter 328: Retreat
paragraphs: Kai moved deeper into Citadel‐09...
As the air conditioning of the base was basically gone, sweat was already dripping down his brow.

’It’s getting hot here... Maybe this thing will just overheat soon? Mhmm? Can they even overheat?’Kai mused as he saw that the Energy Cores of the Mechanical Units seemed to have different principles compared to the batteries or processing units he was aware of.
Nonetheless, Chamber guided him toward the final nodes.
The fortress seemed to sense his intrusion now... every corridor was alive with shifting walls, hidden panels, and traps designed to break his rhythm.
’It’s getting harder and harder to respond even with Chamber giving instructions...’
Kai sighed as he just escaped a series of traps.
[ Alert: Neural Traps detected. ]
Chamber’s voice was hurried...
Kai froze as the floor lit up with faint markings...
Soon, a pulse of energy surged through the air, rattling his nerves.
His muscles stiffened and his vision blurred.
’It’s Neural Trap indeed...’
Just like what Chamber explained before, these traps emit pulses to disrupt Spirit Energy, causing disorientation or paralysis!
"Damn... they’re trying to fry my Spirit Energy." He gritted his teeth, forcing his Strength Gauntlet to activate...
Whom~
The gauntlet’s resonance steadied him long enough to roll clear of the trap!
Adaptive Constructs swarmed next... These mechanical units turned into turrets, even beasts, and humanoid killers!
Plasma bolts rained down.
Kai hurled a smoke grenade, filling the corridor with thick haze!
The machines fired blindly, their sensors disrupted. He slipped through the smoke, War Lance flashing as he pierced a turret’s core.

Another construct lunged, claws snapping. Kai tossed a decoy emitter; a holographic projection of himself sprinted down the hall. The construct chased the false target, giving Kai the opening to smash its dorsal joint with his gauntlet. Sparks erupted, and the machine collapsed.
But the fortress wasn’t done.
Neural Traps pulsed again, chains of energy lashing at his Spirit reserves.
Kai felt his Titan Step failing... It wasn’t just the disturbance... It seemed his Spirit Points were no longer enough!
Kai pulled a Spirit‐Boosting flask from his belt, downing it in one gulp.
Energy surged back into his veins... fifty points was restored instantly. His body roared with renewed vigor...
"Back in the fight."
He activated Titan Step, blurring forward.
Soon, his lance struck one construct three times in rapid succession, exploiting Chamber’s tactical feed.
The third thrust shattered its armor completely!
"Tsk... Why are there so many of you? Shouldn’t you go outside?!" Kai complained as Sentinels stormed in...
They had rifles aimed at him. Kai could only duck behind cover, pulling out his M9 Beretta.
He fired precise shots, each round guided by Chamber’s analysis.

One Sentinel’s rifle exploded in its hands, another slowed down as a bullet pierced its sensor. As soon as the smoke covered them as well, Kai finished them with his gauntlet, smashing cores into scrap!
’It’s easier to fight inside the smoke... But I can’t be too confident.’
Just like that, they got access to another node...
[ Intrusion progress: 64%. ]
Chamber’s voice echoed as Kai defended the spot...
He threw a flashbang grenade into the corridor.
Bang!
The explosion of light blinded the incoming constructs, their sensors overloaded.
Kai then charged forward with War Lance stabbing through their weakened defenses.
Finally, the node’s light started blinking...
Chamber’s hum intensified.
[ Intrusion progress: 100%. Node compromised. Control channel rerouted. ]
Kai exhaled, leaning against the console. "That’s two down... one more. Let’s leave this place...
But Chamber’s tone shifted, almost hesitant.
[ Master... I have discovered something. Control is impossible. The Citadel’s systems are hard‐coded to reject autonomous override. Even if we seize all nodes, I cannot claim ownership. ]
Kai’s eyes narrowed. "So all this hacking... Is it just weakening them? Wait... That should be more than enough... Even if we can’t claim ownership, that’s not a problem."
[ Correct. But we can at least shut the power down. Once the final node collapses, the core will destabilize. The fortress will stop functioning, but it cannot be controlled. ]
Kai clenched his fist. "Figures. Nothing’s ever simple. But that should be more than enough."
Soon, they left the area, heading straight to the last node...
The path to this place was the hardest yet.
Adaptive Constructs poured in waves, shifting forms mid‐battle.
Neural Traps pulsed constantly, draining his Spirit Energy. Kai fought like a storm, every weapon in his arsenal unleashed.
Perhaps, if it wasn’t him fighting here, they would immediately fail.
After all, they wouldn’t have Chamber and numerous resources that could be used...
"The smokescreen is overpowered..." Kai muttered as he realized that the sensor‐disrupting smoke grenades were the real deal... It was truly disrupting the scanners they had on him.
They couldn’t lock unto him because of this!
Furthermore, because the A.I. probably didn’t want to destroy itself, it wasn’t using powerful explosives to kill him!
They were still holding back!
Of course, Kai wouldn’t miss this opportunity...
Smoke grenades cloaked his movements, letting him strike unseen.
Flashbangs stunned machines long enough for his War Lance to pierce their cores.
Decoy emitters drew fire away, buying him precious seconds.
His M9 Beretta would shoot in the dark, crippling sensors and joints of the sentinels and the adaptive constructs...

The Strength Gauntlet smashed through armor and cores, and the War Lance just needed three hits in the same place to destroy almost all types of armor, exploiting every weak point Chamber illuminated.
Whenever his Spirit ran low, Kai drank another Spirit‐Boosting potion, energy flooding back into his body.
At last, battered and bloodied, Kai reached the final chamber. The node pulsed violently. There was glowing like veins of molten light.
[ Master, connect me. This is the last one. ]
Kai unclasped the pendant, pressing it against the port. The filament locked in place. Chamber’s hum filled the room.
[ Initiating final intrusion... progress at 12%. ]
The fortress screamed in response!
The A.I. knew that once they succeeded, it would be over!
This time, even the Ascendants fighting the Level 80 Survivors outside retreated!

"So all this hacking...
Is it just weakening them?
Wait...
That should be more than enough...
Even if we can’t claim ownership, that’s not a problem."
[ Correct.
But we can at least shut the power down.
Once the final node collapses, the core will destabilize.
The fortress will stop functioning, but it cannot be controlled. ]
Kai clenched his fist.
"Figures.
Nothing’s ever simple.
But that should be more than enough."
Soon, they left the area, heading straight to the last node...
The path to this place was the hardest yet.
Adaptive Constructs poured in waves, shifting forms mid‐battle.
Neural Traps pulsed constantly, draining his Spirit Energy.
Kai fought like a storm, every weapon in his arsenal unleashed.
Perhaps, if it wasn’t him fighting here, they would immediately fail.
After all, they wouldn’t have Chamber and numerous resources that could be used...
"The smokescreen is overpowered..." Kai muttered as he realized that the sensor‐disrupting smoke grenades were the real deal...
It was truly disrupting the scanners they had on him.
They couldn’t lock unto him because of this!
Furthermore, because the A.I. probably didn’t want to destroy itself, it wasn’t using powerful explosives to kill him!
They were still holding back!
Of course, Kai wouldn’t miss this opportunity...
Smoke grenades cloaked his movements, letting him strike unseen.
Flashbangs stunned machines long enough for his War Lance to pierce their cores.
Decoy emitters drew fire away, buying him precious seconds.
His M9 Beretta would shoot in the dark, crippling sensors and joints of the sentinels and the adaptive constructs...

The Strength Gauntlet smashed through armor and cores, and the War Lance just needed three hits in the same place to destroy almost all types of armor, exploiting every weak point Chamber illuminated.
Whenever his Spirit ran low, Kai drank another Spirit‐Boosting potion, energy flooding back into his body.
At last, battered and bloodied, Kai reached the final chamber.
The node pulsed violently.
There was glowing like veins of molten light.
[ Master, connect me.
This is the last one. ]
Kai unclasped the pendant, pressing it against the port.
The filament locked in place.
Chamber’s hum filled the room.
[ Initiating final intrusion... progress at 12%. ]
The fortress screamed in response!
The A.I. knew that once they succeeded, it would be over!
This time, even the Ascendants fighting the Level 80 Survivors outside retreated!

chapters.title: Chapter 329: Rescue and Reward
paragraphs: Kai knew that he was now being focused on by the A.I. soldiers.
There was no doubt about that, considering how much damage they had created.
Soon, more Adaptive Constructs surged from every wall, Sentinels also poured in, Neural Traps pulsed nonstop.
Kai fought like a man possessed, every weapon, every skill unleashed in desperate rhythm.
He could tell that his HP was getting lower and lower...
Of course, at the same time, his Spirit Points were also in trouble!
"Shit..." Kai wanted to curse as he realized that if not for his Great Protection and his Advanced Gear, he would have died several times already!
He could only desperately throw everything he could!
Flashbang. Smoke. Titan Step. War Lance. Gauntlet. Beretta. Decoy. Potion.
The chamber was in chaos as Kai wouldn’t let himself get killed!
’Ugh... Why am I even doing this? I should’ve just hidden with my camouflage...’
He couldn’t help but regret it a little. After all, he wasn’t even levelling up since he had to fulfill the condition to break through first!
He was still stuck a Level 39!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (C) ]
[ +50 Experience Points ]
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Adaptive Construct (B) ]
[ +150 Experience Points ]
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (C) ]
[ +50 Experience Points ]
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Neural Trap ]
[ +15 Experience Points ]
[ +50 Experience Points ]
[ +50 Experience Points ]
[ +150 Experience Points ]
[ +15 Experience Points ]
[ +15 Experience Points ]
Although he was getting a lot of experience points, his level was not moving at all!
Right now, he could only pray that the excess Experience Points would be converted once again to turn into Skill Points instead!
That way, he could increase the level of his Great Protection!
’I don’t mind even if it’s 1 Skill Point in exchange for 2,000 Experience Points...’
Kai randomly thought as he heard Chamber’s progress.
[ Progress: 78%... 92%... 100%. Node compromised. Core destabilizing. ]
"I did it!"
Kai’s eyes lit up as the consoles flickered violently.
Chamber’s voice then rang with finality.
[ It is done. Citadel‐09 cannot be controlled. But its power is shutting down. The Ascendants will weaken further. The fortress will no longer release any form of Barrier. ]
Kai staggered as he started breathing hard. "Then let’s just clean them all up!"
Outside, the battlefield continued, but soon, everyone noticed how the Artifact Creatures barely had 50% of their previous resilience...
Even the Ascendants had retreated, allowing the Level 80 Survivors to be freed and eliminate the remaining A.I. Soldiers!
"Something happened inside..."
"Let’s investigate..."
"This is incredible... I really thought that we had a retreat."
At this time, Kai really felt that he had already reached his limit.
Every muscle of his was already screaming in protest.

His War Lance trembled in his grip, the Strength Gauntlet’s glow also flickering as his Spirit Points dwindled. The chamber was littered with broken constructs, shattered Sentinels, and the fading sparks of Neural Traps, but more enemies kept pouring in.
His health bar was dangerously low, and his vision blurred from exhaustion. One more strike from the Adaptive Construct advancing on him would finish it.
Kai raised his lance, but his arms felt heavy, his body sluggish.
’This is it... I can’t hold out anymore.’
The construct charged at him...
As he felt that his life was about to fall... only for it to be blasted back by a surge of radiant energy.
A figure stepped instead... his presence seemed commanding, his aura was unmistakable.
"Cornelio Arries..." Kai whispered, barely believing it. He didn’t expect that this powerful figure from the Aries Faction would be here!
Cornelio, the veteran commander of the Aries faction, stood tall... His armor looked polished as well! It felt as if he didn’t fight anyone outside this Citadel!
Then, his Gene Skill activated.
It was a blazing aura that forced the constructs to recoil.
They had to reassess the danger just like that.
With a single sweep of his weapon, he cleaved through the Adaptive Construct, its body collapsing in sparks and molten parts...
Kai collapsed to one knee, gasping.
Cornelio then finished off all the remaining A.I. Soldiers!
Everything happened so quickly!
Then, his eyes couldn’t help but notice a few things, and he felt alarmed.
"You’ve done something incredible here, Kai," Cornelio said, his voice steady but tinged with awe.

"I felt the fortress’s power vanish. The barriers are gone. The Ascendants are retreating. And you... you’re not even Level 40 yet. I can tell that you’ve really messed up with their drones... You’re incredible."
Kai coughed, forcing a grin. "Guess I... shut it down. I got lucky..."

Of course, Chamber did most of the work... Even if he wanted to be part of the hacking system, the console was just different. He would have to find a way in order to hack these systems on his own in the future.
As for Chamber, he decided to keep its existence a secret for now.
After all, many of these people had families and relatives killed by the A.I.
If they learned that he had allied with one, he would get into trouble for sure.
Even if Chamber was a different entity, it was still part of the A.I. Civilization after all!
At this time, Cornelio’s gaze softened.

He extended a hand, pulling Kai back to his feet. "You’ve done more than most veterans could. Shutting down Citadel‐09’s main power? That’s something even our elites thought impossible. And you did it while still stuck at Level 39."
Kai shook his head, still dazed.
’I thought we could control it. Chamber tried... but the system was locked. All we could do was shut it down.’
"Ahem... If I’m a bit better, we could’ve fully controlled this place. This would be humanity’s first commercialized airship.

Cornelio nodded firmly. He wasn’t sure if Kai was joking or not. "That’s enough. Control was never the goal... You’ve given us a chance to win... In exchange, I’ll help you obtain the Soul Enhancement Serum."

chapters.title: Chapter 330: Looking for Treasure
paragraphs: Kai’s eyes lit up at Cornelio’s words.
The Soul Enhancement Serum, one of the breakthrough requirements he had been chasing, was finally within reach.
His mind immediately recalled the notification he had received before...
[ Current Level: 39 (Max Experience Reached) ]
[ Quest: Forge Your Legacy ]
Requirement 1: Strengthen your foundation further. Possess at least 8 Gene Skills upgraded to Level 7. (Progress: 2/8)
Requirement 2: Possess at least 5 Fused Gene Skills created through Skill Fusion. (Progress: 4/5)
Requirement 3: Consume a Soul Enhancement Serum to unlock higher compatibility with advanced systems. (Progress: 0/1)
[ Reward: Evolutionary Ascension ]
Unlock Veteran Physique Evolution: advanced stat growth, high resilience against elemental hazards, and compatibility with higher‐tier Gene Skills and Zodiac Enhancement.
Title upgrade: ’Expert Survivor’ into ’Veteran of Humanity.’
[ Warning: Survivor will remain capped at Level 39 until all requirements are fulfilled. ]
Kai’s heart pounded.
So this is it... one step closer to ascension.
"Do I have to join the Aries Faction? Will I be tied to your organization?"
Kai immediately asked as he was worried that once he got tied down to a faction, he wouldn’t be able to maximize his talent.

After all, with his Infinite Gift Pack, he really desired to form his own powerful organization and be capable of protecting himself and those close to him. He didn’t want to be at someone’s beck and call of some other organizations that would just benefit from his talent.

"No... This will be special... As long as I give my recommendation together with two of my friends, you can receive the serum without being tied to our organization. You only have to pay for the cost... That would be 20,000 Credits inside the Perfect World."
As saying this, Cornelio noticed more enemies coming...
Though the Citadel’s A.I. had already stopped working, these A.I. Soldiers were still following the last command given to them...
Unfortunately, they were facing a Level 80 Augmented Human!
Cornelio started cutting down the last of the remaining constructs with effortless precision.
His strikes were clean, his movements were swifty, and his aura radiated dominance. Kai couldn’t help but watch in awe.
"See, Kai," Cornelio said, his weapon humming as he cleaved through another Adaptive Construct.

"This is the strength of Aries. Ahem... We don’t just fight... we overwhelm. Our Zodiac trait allows us to double our impact in battle. Every active skill we cast can be repeated once, free of Spirit cost, within three seconds. It’s what makes us unstoppable."
Kai’s eyes widened. "Ah? A free casting of Gene Skill? Wait... So... The Shockwave Slash you used, for example... You can cast it twice in a row?"

Cornelio smirked. "Exactly. Normally, that Gene Skill has a fifteen‐second cooldown. But with Aries’ trait, I can unleash a second strike instantly, no Spirit consumed. It’s devastating in combat. Stonebreaker Impact, Momentum Crash... all of them can be chained. That’s the power of Aries."
Kai was impressed. He recalled Cornelio’s status...
[ Name: Cornelio Aries ]
[ Title: Veteran, Conqueror, Anima’s Target, Aria’s Enemy. ]
[ Level: 80 ]
[ Active Skills: Stonebreaker Impact Lv4, Shockwave Slash Lv3, Momentum Crash Lv5 ]
[ Passive Skills: Hardened Spirit Lv6, Precision Hands Lv5, Indomitable Will Lv7 ]
But what the status didn’t show was the unique Aries trait...
It only showed Cornelio’s last name...
Nonetheless, the ability to duplicate active skills without cost was just too incredible.
Kai realized that every Zodiac faction had something equally extraordinary.
Aries was definitely amazing...
Others, like Pisces or Cancer, surely had their own unique advantages.
Cornelio turned to him, his expression firm but encouraging.

"Kai, you’ve proven yourself today. You shut down Citadel‐09’s power, weakened the Ascendants, and gave us a chance. You did this while still capped at Level 39. That’s remarkable. Aries could really use someone like you. I won’t force you to join us, but I hope you view us positively."
Kai hesitated, gripping his lance tightly. "He was really quite tempted after learning their unique traits...
"Joining Aries... huh. I’ve seen your strength. It’s impressive. But I still have my own path... I’ll probably study all the Zodiac Factions first."

Cornelio chuckled. "Fair enough. But remember, Aries is more than just strength. We are the shield and spear of humanity. If you join us, you’ll gain access to resources, tonics, and training grounds or sparring partners... It wouldn’t be bad to have people around you who understand you."
"I’ll think about it more once I have the Serum." Kai replied.
Together, they eliminated the last remnants of resistance inside the fortress.
Cornelio’s blazing aura tore through constructs, while Kai supported with his remaining grenades and some lance strikes.
The chamber finally fell silent...
"Should we begin looting this place?" Kai asked.
Kai leaned against the wall, exhausted but exhilarated.
Cornelio stood beside him, calm and composed, his aura fading as the battle ended.

"Alright... I’m no longer sensing any enemies. The others are also starting to loot whatever they can above us. Since we’re deeper... We might have a better chance of obtaining decent weapons aside from the ones dropped by the Sentinels. This will probably take some time since, before the shutdown, this fortress closed every door, so accessing the treasures wouldn’t be easy."
"That’s true..."
"Let’s meet outside... I’ll be looting the cores of the Adaptive Constructs that we eliminated. Do you want to follow me?"
"N-no... I’ll look around myself." Kai replied.
Soon, Kai watched Cornelio leave, his crimson aura fading as he moved deeper into the fortress to loot the Adaptive Constructs and harvest their cores.
The veteran’s movements were swift, almost casual, as if dismantling the remnants of units was nothing more than routine.
Then, Kai whispered softly to the pendant. "Chamber... can you open the locked doors he mentioned? Ahem... If Cornelio’s going after the cores, I want to know where the real treasures are."
The pendant pulsed faintly, its voice calm but inquisitive.
[ Define ’treasure,’ master. What do you consider valuable? ]
Kai blinked.
"Treasure? Well, you’re right... There aren’t any gold bars here, that’s for sure. I mean anything useful..."

chapters.title: Chapter 331: Stop
paragraphs: Kai thought for a moment before explaining to Chamber.

"Maybe some kind of Gene Weapons, Gene Enhancement Serum, maybe rare cores, enhancement items, or even blueprints on how to build this thing... Oh, now that I think about it, how about the barrier? Do you think we take that technology? Does it have some kind of special materials that produce that Barrier? I just need anything that could give me an edge."
Well, he had an Advanced Barrier Generator, but that thing uses a lot of resources just to activate. Furthermore, it was just one layer of defense.
If possible, Kai wanted to have more of them.
In any case, Chamber finally had an idea of the things he considered treasures.
Chamber hummed for some time, processing the information it had.
[ Understood. Analyzing fortress schematics. Identifying potential caches. ]
Kai waited, his heart pounding with anticipation.
Cornelio might be focused on the obvious loot, but Kai had Chamber... a tool that could see beyond locked doors and hidden compartments.
Moments later, Chamber’s voice returned, listing its findings.
[ Ten potential treasure sites detected. ]
As soon as he heard this, Kai’s eyes lit up.
Still, he controlled his emotions.
Now that the battle was over... All the remaining Survivors would be searching for these treasures!
He had to assume that the others could’ve found these treasures already.
"Tell me more about it," Kai said.
Just like that, the unique A.I., Chamber, showed the information he needed...
[ 1. Neural Trap Storage Bay. Dozens of inactive traps stored for deployment. With modification, they could be repurposed into portable stun devices. ]
[ 2. Explosives Depot. Crates of fragmentation orbs and shockwave charges. They’re defective but salvageable. ]
[ 3. Prototype Weapon Lab. Incomplete plasma rifles and vibro‐edge blades. ]
[ 4. Energy Core Vault. Several B‐grade and C‐grade cores, used to power A.I. Units. ]
[ 5. Gene Skill Crystal Chamber. Small cache of defective but usable crystals, including special variants. ]
[ 6. Adaptive Construct Workshop. Spare modular parts, potentially useful for crafting or upgrading gear. ]
[ 7. Medical Bay for Captured Humans. Tonics, stimulants, and possibly Gene Serums. ]
[ 8. Data Archive. Encrypted files that might contain representations or tactical information. ]
[ 9. Armor Storage. Reinforced armor and gauntlet components.
[ 10. Experimental Node. A sealed chamber with unknown readings. ]
Chamber noted high-energy signatures, possibly dangerous but potentially rewarding.
Kai was getting excited.
That’s... incredible. If we can get even half... No, maybe of that, it’ll be worth more than anything Cornelio’s pulling from those constructs."
[ I can attempt to override the locks once I get closer... However, some doors are reinforced. It will take time. ]
Kai nodded. "Do it. Start with the Neural Trap Storage Bay. Those traps could be turned into portable stun grenades. I’ll need them if I’m going to survive against higher‐tier enemies."
Just like that, Kai followed Chamber’s instruction, and whenever they were blocked by thick metal gates, the pendant would pulse..
[ Beginning override. Estimated time: two minutes. ]

Weapons, explosives, cores, crystals... This fortress might be a goldmine if I play it right.

Inside, rows of inactive Neural Traps lined the walls!

"Perfect..." he muttered. "With Chamber’s help, I can reprogram these into portable stun grenades. They’ll be risky, but worth it."

"Whoa~ This is very well hidden," Kai commented.
The corridor leading to the depot was deceptively ordinary.
To get here, he passed through some rusted panels, sealed doors, and narrow walkways that gave no hint of what lay beyond.
To any survivor, it looked like a dead end... just another section of Citadel‐09 abandoned after the shutdown.
But Chamber’s pulse guided Kai forward!
[ Hidden sub‐layer detected. This section was deliberately masked. Without prior schematics and adaptive bypass protocols, discovery would be impossible. ]
Kai smirked.
’So that’s why Cornelio didn’t even glance this way. He’s strong, but brute force won’t open what you can’t even see. Hehehe...’
The fortress had been designed with layers of deception.
False walls concealed storage bays, while encrypted locks shifted their codes every few minutes. Even if someone tried to brute‐force their way in, the system would probably reroute them endlessly.
Only Chamber, with its archived data and ability to slip past dormant command lines, could reveal these hidden caches.
Kai pressed his hand against the door...
To his eyes, it was just steel. But Chamber highlighted faint handles... It was invisible without its guidance.

Without it, he would have walked past this place a hundred times, never realizing the depot was here.
But then, Kai noticed something!
"Wait, Chamber! Stop!"

chapters.title: Chapter 332: Intruders
paragraphs: A few moments after Chamber confirmed that it needed 90 seconds, Kai froze.
His senses noticed something. The faint echo of footsteps reached him from the corridor beyond.
"Humans..." he muttered under his breath.
"Wait, Chamber! Stop!"
Chamber immediately did so and even without instruction, it pulsed softly.
[ Three signatures detected. Approaching rapidly. ]
Kai’s eyes narrowed. His senses were right...
They were most likely mercenaries.
Their movements weren’t like those of high-level Survivors.
As they stepped into view, he recognized the insignia stitched onto their armor... Cancer Faction’s crest.
’So they’re Cancer’s hired blades...’
Kai took a deep breath.
He didn’t really like these people...
So, if the depot door opened now, they would see everything inside. And mercenaries, especially those not yet bound to a Zodiac, would fight tooth and nail for resources.
"Can you estimate their level or their status, Chamber?"
[ Sure. ]
To be honest, he wasn’t really sure if Chamber could do it.
Kai didn’t even dare to order this A.I. Assistant to analyze Cornelio a while ago since the man was Level 80. He was afraid that the man would notice Chamber.
But now, he felt a little more comfortable seeing how these guys didn’t have the best equipment out there.
Thankfully, Chamber actually succeeded!
[ Target 1: Male with Twin Daggers ]
[ Level: 39
Health: Unknown
Spirit: Unknown
Active Skills: Phase Shift Lv1, Phantom Step Lv6, Dual Fang Slash Lv5
Passive Skills: Quick Reflex Lv4, Opportunist Lv3 ]
[ Assessment: Speed-based combatant. Relies on feints and rapid strikes.
Weakness: Overextension during chain attacks. ]
’Huh? You can tell their Gene Skills?!’
Kai was shocked, but he didn’t voice his thoughts!
’Still, they only have four skills? No... Maybe Chamber can only detect four Skills. It’s possible that there’s a limit to how many skills Chamber could detect.’
After taking a deep breath, Kai controlled his expression and checked the other two.
[ Target 2: Female with Crimson Blade ]
[ Level: 39
Health: Unknown
Spirit: Unknown
Active Skills: Phase Shift Lv3, Crimson Edge Lv5
Passive Skills: Spatial Awareness Lv4, Adaptive Instinct Lv3 ]
[ Assessment: Phase ability allows passage through solid matter for 3 seconds. Vulnerable during re-materialization.
Weakness: Predictable timing after phasing. ]
’Phase Shift? Isn’t that a bit too good?’Kai thought as checked the last.
[ Target 3: Male with Heavy Axe ]
Level: 39
Health: Unknown
Spirit: Unknown
Active Skills: Phase Shift Lv1, Titan Swing Lv6, Iron Crash Lv5
Passive Skills: Hardened Muscles Lv5, Berserk Fury Lv4 ]
[ Assessment: Strength-based combatant. Devastating power but slow recovery after heavy swings.
Weakness: Easily countered during cooldown windows. ]
Chamber’s voice followed.
[ Conclusion: All three are capped at Level 39. Combat strength comparable to user.
Probability of hostile engagement: 87%. Recommend caution. ]
Kai’s eyes narrowed as he absorbed the data.So they’re exactly like me... capped, waiting for Level 40. Mercenaries without a faction yet. If they see the depot open, they’ll fight for it.
He exhaled slowly, tightening his grip on his lance. "Alright... I understand."
At Level 39, they were capped just like him, waiting for the threshold of Level 40 to force them into choosing a faction.
Unless, of course, they were like Kai... building their own path, their own organization.
The three stopped when they saw him. Their eyes lit up as curiosity flashed across their faces.
"Well, well," one of them said, a tall man daggers...
"How did you get here so fast? This place isn’t exactly easy to reach."
Kai didn’t answer immediately. He studied them carefully...
Another mercenary, a woman with short crimson blade, tilted her head.
"Did you loot something already?" she asked, her tone deceptively casual.
Kai shook his head slowly. "No. I’m leaving."
But the three exchanged glances.
They knew how difficult this section of Citadel‐09 was to access.

The only reason they had managed to get here was because of their Gene Skill... It was Phase Shift. It was an ability that allowed them to phase through solid objects, slipping past barriers that would have stopped anyone else.
At this time, Kai’s warriness made them feel that he was hiding something.
"I’m sure he’s lying," the scarred man muttered. "Nobody gets this deep without finding something."
The third mercenary, a broad‐shouldered brute wielding a heavy axe, stepped forward.
"Then we’ll just have to make sure. Capture him. If he has loot, we’ll take it."
Kai’s grip tightened on his lance. As expected, the people from the Cancer Faction could not be trusted...
He had no choice.
Chamber pulsed again, its voice calm and analytical.
[ Threat assessment: Three opponents. Estimated combat strength equal to user. Weaknesses identified. Recommend immediate engagement. ]
The mercenaries charged forward.
The scarred man struck first, his twin daggers were soon in action!
He moved with speed, aiming for Kai’s throat!
They were not just planning to capture him, they were here planning to kill him!
Kai dodged with his lance, intercepting the strike!
Clang!
Sparks flew as steel met steel.
The crimson-haired woman, who also had a crimson blade, followed!
Her Gene Skill activated!
Her body turned corporeal, phasing partially through Kai’s lance, before reappearing behind Kai. She swung her blade in a downward arc, aiming to cleave his back.
Kai spun... Not expecting that this Phase Shift could be used like this...
Still, he knew that it had a limit!
Soon, his Lance swept in a wide arc. The weapon’s shaft caught her strike, deflecting it with precision.
He kicked forward, forcing her back.
The brute roared, charging with his axe raised high.
His Gene Skill enhanced his strength, the weapon glowing faintly as he brought it down with crushing force!
Kai sidestepped; the axe smashed into the floor!
Boom!
Dust and fragments exploded upward.
"You keep dodging! Just stop moving!"
Kai obviously didn’t listen as he thrust his lance forward, piercing the brute’s shoulder. The man bellowed in pain, staggering.
But the mercenaries weren’t ordinary fighters.
They regrouped quickly, circling him.
"Not bad," the scarred man hissed. "But you’re alone. You can’t win against three."
As soon as the man said this, he injected something into himself, turning his skin red!

chapters.title: Chapter 333: Against the Three
paragraphs: Kai’s eyes widened as the scarred man’s veins bulged and his skin started flushing crimson. The drug coursed through his body like wildfire, amplifying his strength and speed.
His daggers trembled in his grip before they began vibrating with unnatural energy.
Kai hadn’t expected them to be this eager to eliminate him.
But it seemed that he had underestimated their greed!
Apparently, the mercenaries knew more survivors would eventually reach this section of Citadel‐09.
If they wanted to secure loot and escape without suspicion, they had to kill him quickly, strip him of anything valuable, and leave no evidence behind.
Kai felt the pressure...
’So that’s how it is...’
He had no choice but to fight to kill as well.
The scarred man charged forward with, his daggers blurring faster than before.
Kai threw a smoke grenade to the ground.
It immediately released a thick gray mist, swallowing the corridor in seconds. Visibility dropped to nothing!
"Smoke?!" one of them snarled.
Kai’s silhouette vanished into the haze.
He quickly disengaged his two Gene Weapons, the Strength Gauntlet and the War Lance, letting them dissolve back into dormant form.
His Spirit pulsed as he manifested something else.
The dagger materialized in his hand. It was sleek and dark, and seemed quite ordinary...
[ Gene Weapon: Specter Edge ]
[ Grade: Mid ]
[ Type: Spirit‐Infused Dagger ]
[ Effects: +15% Armor Penetration against mechanical units.
Signal Disruption: Attacks have a chance to disable enemy sensors. ]
[ Hidden Attribute: Decay ]
Kai’s grip tightened around the dagger.
As soon as he poured some Spirit Energy on it, its edge started blurring, as if reality itself bent around it.
The heavy-axe user then swung his axe blindly through the smoke.
The blade smashed into the wall, but it didn’t stop him!
The crimson‐haired woman phased through the mist, with her blade slashing in the air.
But Kai was already moving.
"Titan Step," he whispered.
His body surged forward as Spirit energy flooded his muscles...
Bam!
The ground cracked beneath his feet as he accelerated!
His figure passed through the smoke and aimed at the dagger user!
The scarred man’s daggers slashed wildly, enhanced by the drug.
Chamber pulsed in Kai’s mind.
[ Analysis: Drug amplification detected. Speed increased by 40%. Stamina drain imminent. Recommend counter through attrition. ]
Kai ducked low, Specter Edge flashing. The dagger sliced across the man’s forearm, leaving a trail of black decay.
The scarred mercenary hissed at the sudden pain, and just like that, his movements slowed for a fraction of a second.
"Wha—what is this?!" he shouted while, clutching his arm.
Kai didn’t answer.
He pressed forward, his dagger moving through the mist.
Each strike was perfect, guided by Chamber’s analysis.
Kai struck again with Specter Edge, piercing the man’s ribs.
The hidden attribute activated... Decay.
The wound darkened, spreading corruption through his flesh.
The mercenary had no other choice but to reconsider his move! After all, his enhanced speed seemed to have been suppressed by the dagger’s effect!
"Careful! He’s using poison!" The man warned.
The crimson‐haired woman phased through the smoke, appearing behind Kai.
However, Chamber noticed this even before she manifested.
[ Re‐materialization detected behind you. ]
Kai quickly turned with his dagger, before slashing upward.
Clang!
The blade tore across her chest just as she solidified.
She screamed, stumbling back, with blood spilling from the wound!
The axe-user then roared, charging blindly.
His axe cut through the mist, smashing into the floor again.
He was too slow!
Kai sidestepped, his dagger stabbing into the man’s thigh.
It was not enough to kill the man, but it should slowly drain him!
However, the man actually cried in pain before he collapsed to one knee.
’Ohh... You have low pain tolerance?’Kai smiled at this discovery...
As he was about to finish him off, however, the drugged scarred man moved! He wasn’t finished yet.
He charged again with his daggers glowing with crimson energy.
Kai blocked, sparks flying as steel clashed.
The man’s strength was overwhelming, forcing Kai back.
It seems that the drug’s effect was just working now!
’He doesn’t care about injuries... Wait... Did he take more drugs while I’m not looking?’
Kai frowned as his HP dropped with each glancing blow.
He gritted his teeth.I can’t let them overwhelm me.
Another smoke grenade hissed, thickening the haze. The mercenaries coughed, their vision completely obscured.
Kai then vanished into the mist, his footsteps silent.
"Where is he?!" the axe-user roared as he suppressed the pain...
Kai’s voice whispered from the smoke. "Right here."
Specter Edge flashed, piercing the brute’s throat.
The man gurgled, before collapsing to the ground.
Thud!
"Max!" The crimson‐haired woman screamed in rage, phasing again.
But Kai was ready.
He ducked, used Spirit Dominion to control her movements before using Titan Step!
"You-!"
The woman was surprised as this was Kai’s first time using Spirit Dominion against them!
Kai did this deliberately to maximize its power!
His dagger slashed across her neck, severing her cry abruptly...
Soon, she also fell, lifeless.
Thud!
Only the scarred man remained, his body trembling from the drug.
His daggers glowed as he was filled with fury!
His Spirit Points must be draining fast!
Then, he began slashing wildly! Kai could see desperation in his eyes.
Kai blocked, his dagger intercepting each strike. Though the man was fast, his attacks became more predictable...
Kai smirked.Time to end this.
He surged forward as the cooldown was over...
Soon, Titan Step propelled him like a bullet.
Bam!
Then, the Specter Edge pierced the man’s chest, driving deep.
The hidden attribute activated again as Decay began spreading through his body.
"Y-you!"
The mercenary gasped, blood spilling from his mouth, before collapsing to the ground.
Silence returned to the corridor.
Kai stood over the fallen mercenaries as he looked around...
’That’s close...’
He muttered while looking at his HP.
He exhaled slowly, wiping the blood from Specter Edge.
’Barely made it... but I won.’
Still, he believed that the battle gathered some attention...
Because of that, he quickly looted these people!
After rummaging through their belongings, he discovered the stimulant that the scarred-man used!
Without hesitation, Kai used his Appraisal.

The scarred man charged forward with, his daggers blurring faster than before.
Kai threw a smoke grenade to the ground.
It immediately released a thick gray mist, swallowing the corridor in seconds.
Visibility dropped to nothing!
"Smoke?!" one of them snarled.
Kai’s silhouette vanished into the haze.
He quickly disengaged his two Gene Weapons, the Strength Gauntlet and the War Lance, letting them dissolve back into dormant form.
His Spirit pulsed as he manifested something else.
The dagger materialized in his hand.
It was sleek and dark, and seemed quite ordinary...
[ Gene Weapon: Specter Edge ]
[ Grade: Mid ]
[ Type: Spirit‐Infused Dagger ]
[ Effects: +15% Armor Penetration against mechanical units.
Signal Disruption: Attacks have a chance to disable enemy sensors. ]
[ Hidden Attribute: Decay ]
Kai’s grip tightened around the dagger.
As soon as he poured some Spirit Energy on it, its edge started blurring, as if reality itself bent around it.
The heavy-axe user then swung his axe blindly through the smoke.
The blade smashed into the wall, but it didn’t stop him!
The crimson‐haired woman phased through the mist, with her blade slashing in the air.
But Kai was already moving.
"Titan Step," he whispered.
His body surged forward as Spirit energy flooded his muscles...
Bam!
The ground cracked beneath his feet as he accelerated!
His figure passed through the smoke and aimed at the dagger user!
The scarred man’s daggers slashed wildly, enhanced by the drug.
Chamber pulsed in Kai’s mind.
[ Analysis: Drug amplification detected.
Speed increased by 40%.
Stamina drain imminent.
Recommend counter through attrition. ]
Kai ducked low, Specter Edge flashing.
The dagger sliced across the man’s forearm, leaving a trail of black decay.
The scarred mercenary hissed at the sudden pain, and just like that, his movements slowed for a fraction of a second.
"Wha—what is this?!" he shouted while, clutching his arm.
Kai didn’t answer.
He pressed forward, his dagger moving through the mist.
Each strike was perfect, guided by Chamber’s analysis.
Kai struck again with Specter Edge, piercing the man’s ribs.
The hidden attribute activated...
Decay.
The wound darkened, spreading corruption through his flesh.
The mercenary had no other choice but to reconsider his move!
After all, his enhanced speed seemed to have been suppressed by the dagger’s effect!
"Careful!
He’s using poison!" The man warned.
The crimson‐haired woman phased through the smoke, appearing behind Kai.
However, Chamber noticed this even before she manifested.
[ Re‐materialization detected behind you. ]
Kai quickly turned with his dagger, before slashing upward.
Clang!
The blade tore across her chest just as she solidified.
She screamed, stumbling back, with blood spilling from the wound!
The axe-user then roared, charging blindly.
His axe cut through the mist, smashing into the floor again.
He was too slow!
Kai sidestepped, his dagger stabbing into the man’s thigh.
It was not enough to kill the man, but it should slowly drain him!
However, the man actually cried in pain before he collapsed to one knee.
’Ohh...
You have low pain tolerance?’Kai smiled at this discovery...
As he was about to finish him off, however, the drugged scarred man moved!
He wasn’t finished yet.
He charged again with his daggers glowing with crimson energy.
Kai blocked, sparks flying as steel clashed.
The man’s strength was overwhelming, forcing Kai back.
It seems that the drug’s effect was just working now!
’He doesn’t care about injuries...
Wait...
Did he take more drugs while I’m not looking?’
Kai frowned as his HP dropped with each glancing blow.
He gritted his teeth.I can’t let them overwhelm me.
Another smoke grenade hissed, thickening the haze.
The mercenaries coughed, their vision completely obscured.
Kai then vanished into the mist, his footsteps silent.
"Where is he?!" the axe-user roared as he suppressed the pain...
Kai’s voice whispered from the smoke.
"Right here."
Specter Edge flashed, piercing the brute’s throat.
The man gurgled, before collapsing to the ground.
Thud!
"Max!" The crimson‐haired woman screamed in rage, phasing again.
But Kai was ready.
He ducked, used Spirit Dominion to control her movements before using Titan Step!
"You-!"
The woman was surprised as this was Kai’s first time using Spirit Dominion against them!
Kai did this deliberately to maximize its power!
His dagger slashed across her neck, severing her cry abruptly...
Soon, she also fell, lifeless.
Thud!
Only the scarred man remained, his body trembling from the drug.
His daggers glowed as he was filled with fury!
His Spirit Points must be draining fast!
Then, he began slashing wildly!
Kai could see desperation in his eyes.
Kai blocked, his dagger intercepting each strike.
Though the man was fast, his attacks became more predictable...
Kai smirked.Time to end this.
He surged forward as the cooldown was over...
Soon, Titan Step propelled him like a bullet.
Bam!
Then, the Specter Edge pierced the man’s chest, driving deep.
The hidden attribute activated again as Decay began spreading through his body.
"Y-you!"
The mercenary gasped, blood spilling from his mouth, before collapsing to the ground.
Silence returned to the corridor.
Kai stood over the fallen mercenaries as he looked around...
’That’s close...’
He muttered while looking at his HP.
He exhaled slowly, wiping the blood from Specter Edge.
’Barely made it... but I won.’
Still, he believed that the battle gathered some attention...
Because of that, he quickly looted these people!
After rummaging through their belongings, he discovered the stimulant that the scarred-man used!
Without hesitation, Kai used his Appraisal.

chapters.title: Chapter 334: Looted and the Depot
paragraphs: There were 12 of these stimulants in total, so Kai was looking forward to seeing what they could do.
[ Fast Appraisal Activated ]
[ Spirit Point Cost: 10 ]
[ Cooldown: 15 seconds ]
Kai held up the vial of stimulant with its liquid swirling faintly with a crimson hue.
[ You have discovered Blood Surge Stimulant! ]
[ Grade: Hazardous Consumable ]

[ Description: A 15mL injectable compound synthesized from unstable spirit-reactive compounds. Temporarily boosts physical strength and speed by 40%, while suppressing pain receptors. Highly addictive and corrosive to the body’s natural Spirit circuits. ]
[ Note: Duration - 3 minutes. Side effects include rapid stamina drain, internal bleeding, and permanent Spirit Point reduction if abused. Classified as a mercenary-grade combat enhancer. ]
’So that’s what gave him that unnatural speed... but it’s not good in the long run.Hmm... If it’s not highly addictive, it was quite decent...
Indeed, if that side effect were gone, Kai would probably use it.
In any case, he looted them all just in case they could be sold. Well, he recalled that he had to pay 20,000 credits to get the Soul Enhancement Serum.
Because of that, he needed more items here that he could sold for a high price.
For now, he turned his attention to the weapons scattered near the corpses.
The scarred man’s twin daggers gleamed faintly, their edges were still sharp despite the repeated use.
Since they were all quite precious, Kai decided to use his own Appraisal once again instead of asking Chamber to analyse them.
Here, Kai realized that they were linked. Appraising one of them was enough to learn about the two daggers.
[ You have discovered Fangpiercer Daggers! ]
[ Grade: Rare Grade Weapon ]
[ Type: Dual Spirit-Linked Daggers ]

[ Description: Lightweight blades designed for rapid strikes and feints. Spirit infusion enhances cutting speed and allows limited penetration against reinforced armor. Commonly used by mercenaries for assassination missions. ]
[ Note: Durability compromised. Spirit efficiency reduced by 20%. ]
"So I still have to repair it, huh.
Next, Kai picked up the crimson-haired woman’s blade. Its surface shimmered faintly, resonating with her Phase Shift ability.
[ You have discovered Crimson Phase Blade! ]
[ Grade: Rare Grade Weapon ]
[ Type: Spirit-Linked Sword ]

[ Description: A blade forged with phase-reactive alloys. When paired with Phase Shift, it can partially bypass physical defenses, striking targets through solid matter. Effective against barriers and fortified armor. ]
[ Note: Requires Phase Shift compatibility for full effect. Without it, the weapon functions as a standard Spirit blade. ]
"Eh? Isn’t this too awesome? Why did she fail to use it effectively?" Kai was confused. Still, if he were to make a guess, the Phase Shift Skill probably takes a lot of Spirit Points when used.
After all, it would be too overpowered if the phasing of the weapon were a standard move.
Finally, Kai examined the large man’s heavy axe.
Its weight was immense, the weapon designed purely for brute force.
[ You have discovered Titanbreaker Axe! ]
[ Grade: Rare Grade Weapon ]
[ Type: Heavy Spirit-Infused Axe ]

[ Description: A massive axe built for overwhelming strength. Spirit infusion amplifies impact force, capable of shattering heavy armor. Highly inefficient in Spirit consumption, but devastating in close combat. ]
[ Note: Weapon strain detected. It had destabilized Spirit circuits, reducing operational lifespan. ]
Kai exhaled slowly, storing the stimulant and weapons into his inventory.
’They’re all kinda dangerous. No wonder they thought they could kill me. Still, Specter Edge outclassed them all.’
Kai thought to himself as he removed some food from his Inventory and replaced them with the three weapons.
As for the Blood Surge Stimulant, Kai just kept them inside his pocket.
Kai glanced at his status window again.
He actually recovered 9 points just now thanks to his Title’s Effect.
Still, his body ached. The battle had drained him more than he realized.
’I can’t keep moving like this... If another fight breaks out, I’ll be finished.’
Without hesitation, Kai pulled out one of his rare medical items.
[ Item: Phoenix Regeneration Kit ]
[ Description: A medical kit containing medical equipment and 5 rare recovery serums capable of reviving a mortally wounded survivor within minutes. ]
It was worth 525 Survivor Medals in the Auction!
Of course, this time wasn’t taking up a space in his Inventory since the Auction Items had a different slot.
Anyway, Kai opened the kit, revealing a few recovery items, but he focused on a sleek injector filled with a glowing amber liquid.
The serum glowed faintly, radiating warmth even through the casing.
He pressed the injector against his arm and activated it.
The effect was immediate.
A surge of vitality coursed through his veins, burning away the fatigue and pain.
His wounds began to close, the bleeding stopped, and his muscles tightened with renewed strength.
[ Health Restored: 3,200 / 3,200 ]
It may seem like he had wasted it, considering it could heal even those mortally wounded.
However, Kai knew that he had to appear like he was completely fine. This would help him ensure that no one would suspect him of killing these three.
Though he could say that he was acting in self-defense, the Cancer Faction could still cause him or his shop some trouble.
Kai exhaled sharply, feeling the difference.
His body no longer trembled, his vision cleared, and his Spirit circuits stabilized.
’Whew... Incredible... It’s like being reborn.’
He flexed his fingers, gripping Specter Edge tightly before sending the dagger away...
Kai then glanced at the kit again. Only four uses remained.
Then, he stored them back in his inventory...
After that, he looked at the food he had taken out of his inventory and the three corpses.
In the end, Kai had Chamber open the Explosives Depot without any issues...
Here, he found so many explosives, as the name suggested...
However, the first thing he did was to drag the three corpses inside and close the door with Chamber’s help!
After all, he believed that without Chamber’s help, the others would fail to even find the door!
When this was all done, Kai finally focused on the items inside the room...
There were numerous cannon shells inside, but what he realized was the fact that some of them seemed to be too precious!
"W-wait... Are these Cannon Balls made of Aetherium?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 335: The Poultry Grounds
paragraphs: In the meantime, while Kai was busying himself to obtain more treasures, the Codebreaker Shelter remained busy...
After all, this place still needed more construction even if the wall was already done.
What had once been a forgotten ruin was slowly becoming a thriving hub of survivors, thanks to Kai’s decision to converge all scattered shelters into one unified base.
Maris stretched her arms, feeling the faint ache of muscles that had grown stronger since her days in the Blue Grass Shelter.
Back then, she had been Level 5, barely surviving on scraps and water she could forage.
Now, at Level 9, she had responsibilities and a role that mattered.
[ Name: Maris ]
[ Title: None ]
[ Level: 9 ]
[ Physique Rating: D‐ ]
[ Active Skills: None]
[ Passive Skills: Forager’s Instinct Lv2, Gentle Touch Lv1 ]
[ Forager’s Instinct (Level 2): Improves ability to identify edible plants and safe water sources. Increases efficiency when gathering food by 15%. ]
[ Gentle Touch (Level 1): Animals under care respond positively, reducing stress and improving yield. ]
With these two passive skills, she was easily assigned to be one of the caretakers of their poultry!
Indeed, at this time, Maris’ destination was the poultry grounds.
The trade with Harper in the Auction Realm had been a turning point.
Eighty hens and ten roosters had been secured, a treasure beyond measure in this world.
Eggs meant food, barter, and even the possibility of raising more chickens for long‐term sustainability.
Maris nodded at one of the carers assigned to the flock as he had already finished his shift.

Well, aside from collecting eggs, they had to always keep this place clean, ensure the chicken’s good health, and also, they had to guard this place just in case someone tried to steal the eggs or even capture the chicken to be cooked.
For now, she entered the poultry shed, a structure patched together from scavenged wood, corrugated metal, with simple fencing.
The place was filled with the soft clucking of hens, the occasional crow of a rooster, and the earthy smell of straw.
"Morning, girls," Maris said softly with her voice carrying warmth.
The hens responded with gentle clucks, moving toward her as if recognizing her presence.
Her passive skill, Gentle Touch, had begun to manifest in subtle ways.
The animals were calmer around her, less prone to stress, and more consistent in their egg production.
She checked the feeding troughs first. Grain had been rationed carefully, mixed with scraps from the shelter’s kitchens. Water was stored in clay basins, purified daily.
Maris crouched, inspecting the hens one by one.
She looked for signs of illness... drooping wings, dull feathers, sluggish movement.
Her Forager’s Instinct helped her identify natural remedies, herbs she could mix into their feed to keep them healthy.
Satisfied, she moved to the nesting boxes.
Eggs gleamed faintly in the straw. She counted carefully, placing each one into a basket lined with cloth.
Apparently, the previous carer focused more on cleaning the place and feeding the chickens instead of collecting eggs.
"One... two... three..." she whispered as she counted the eggs while collecting them.
By the time she finished, she had collected nearly sixty eggs. It was a good yield.
Her work didn’t end there.
Maris carried the basket to the storage room, where eggs were sorted.
Most of them were kept for food... But a few were set aside for incubation.
Apparently, the Codebreakers Shelter had begun experimenting with hatching chicks, hoping to expand the flock further.
Maris then recorded the numbers on a ledger...
Since Kai had insisted on proper tracking of resources, she just had to follow instructions since every egg mattered.
After the collection, Maris returned to the poultry grounds to clean.
She thought of replacing the old straw, but they seemed fine for now, so instead of that, she scrubbed the basins and repaired a section of fencing that had been weakened by last night’s rain.
When everything was done, she wiped sweat from her brow, smiling faintly.
’It’s hard work... but it feels good to be useful.’
By midday, she joined the others for a brief meal.
There was Randel, who was now assigned to construction, Emiru, who was still helping with farming, and Leron, who was now part of the patrol squad.
The four of them were close friends in Blue Grass Shelter before and it didn’t stop after entering this new shelter.
Soon, they sat on overturned crates, eating boiled eggs and bread.
"We’re already building the fourth watchtower... It’s really cool. You should try climbing it later." Randel remarked.
"Ohhh... But it’s still quite scary... What if you get sniped by the Spyders?"
"Heh... The barrier we have isn’t just for display, noh?"
Leron and Maris said as they looked at each other.
"Wait... Did you know what we’ve planted right now? Corn! Corn! Someday, we will have corn in the shelter! I heard it was purchased from the Auction. It was when the Foreign Survivors disappeared."
That was definitely good news!
Just like that, the friends discussed some updates or various random information within the shelter, including the mysterious Super Soldiers who were helping in the construction and also security.
After lunch, Maris checked the incubators.
They were crude... wooden boxes lined with cloth, warmed by several lamps.
Inside, a dozen eggs rested, their shells faintly glowing from the light...
She then adjusted the lamps, ensuring the temperature remained stable.
Her Gentle Touch skill seemed to extend here too. The chicks inside seemed to develop steadily. In any case, their survival rate was higher than expected.
Then, the afternoon was spent repairing the shed roof. Rain had leaked through, dampening the straw. Maris climbed carefully, hammering scavenged planks into place.
By evening, the poultry grounds were secure again.
As the sun set, Maris carried the final basket of eggs to the shelter’s kitchen. The cooks greeted her warmly, their eyes lighting up at the sight.
"It’s finally here..." one of the cooks exclaimed as Maris set down the basket of eggs.
Mila, the chef, stepped forward with excitement.
In her hands was a small pouch wrapped carefully in cloth.
"This," she said, unwrapping it, "was brought back by Ralph’s hunting team. They found it clinging to the cliffs... It’s rare... very rare."
Inside was a cluster of delicate strands. They were translucent and slightly sticky.
Maris tilted her head. "What is it?"
"Swiftlet’s nest," Mila explained. "The hardened saliva of a bird... and this one’s quite special."

chapters.title: Chapter 336: The Eggs and Lumber
paragraphs: "Swiftlet?" Maris repeated as she heard the name of the bird.
"Yes... It’s a mutated one, so it has some enhanced effects like that Golden Bull from before." Mila explained.

"Previously, it was used to make a soup prized for its richness and healing properties. It’s said to strengthen the body, restore vitality, and even help with recovery from illness. Now... It’s not just a rumor. It really has the effect already."
The others murmured in awe as soon as they heard this.
Mila smiled faintly.
"We’ll need eggs to balance the flavor. Good thing you brought plenty today."
She set to work immediately.
A pot was filled with purified water, and the strands of the nest were soaked until they softened.
Eggs were cracked and whisked, then poured slowly into the simmering broth.
Soon, the mixture thickened, turning into a golden soup with delicate threads floating inside.
"Whoa~"
"This smell is amazing."
"That’s true."
The aroma spread quickly through the kitchen.
Survivors nearby lifted their heads as they were curious about the smell coming from their place...
Food had always been simple.
There were canned goods, noodles, dried meat, and they would just add some herbs and other greens from time to time...
Then, recently, boiled eggs were added once a day.
After that, they were able to obtain some flour, and they were able to have a steady supply of bread...
This time, however, what they were about to have was something rare, something that was considered a luxury from a world long gone.
Maris watched as Mila stirred carefully...
"This will be shared tonight," Mila said firmly. "Everyone has worked hard. They deserve something special."
By evening, the soup was served in clay bowls. Survivors gathered eagerly, and their faces lit up as they tasted it.
The flavor was delicate yet rich, the eggs blending smoothly with the softened strands of the nest.
It was absolutely incredible...
Randel grinned after his first sip.
"This... this is incredible. It feels like my whole body’s warming up."
Emiru nodded. "It’s like medicine and food at the same time. Maybe we can check the Status Crystal later. I think that it had some mystical effects, but we can’t see it."
"T-that’s true. Only the Foreign Survivors could immediately check their stats. I wonder if they’re getting notifications about it."
"I’m sure they do... I heard Sir Victor and Sir Wallace talk about it."
"Well, since we’re only working inside the shelter, it doesn’t really matter. I guess those who were hunting outside the shelter would really need such buffs."
Maris said as she smiled softly, watching her friends enjoy the rare dish.
She herself felt a gentle warmth spreading through her chest, her fatigue easing. She knew that the effect was legit...
Still, she couldn’t help but wonder what kind of Clan that Eclipse Revenant was.
After all, she heard from Vera and the others that the Chickens came from a man called Harper.
Perhaps, they also have other poultry animals or maybe even farm animals...
Meanwhile, outside, the rumble of wheels echoed across the dirt road leading into Codebreakers Shelter.
A massive cart, made with scavenged steel and bound with thick ropes, creaked under the weight of freshly cut lumber.
At the front was Joe, one of the Superhuman Guild’s trusted members.
His four arms gripped the reins and pushed the cart forward with steady strength.
Despite his mutations, Joe’s mind remained intact. He was still sharp, calculating, and disciplined.
Grimm, the guild leader, had chosen him precisely for this reason. Unlike many of their kind who had succumbed to madness or instinct, Joe was still intelligent enough to handle trade.

Behind him, four other mutated humans followed, their bodies twisted in different ways, with elongated limbs, hardened skin, or extra eyes... but all of them were disciplined enough to serve. Together, they dragged the cart into view, the lumber stacked high and neatly arranged.
Joe raised his voice as they reached the gates.
"Delivery from the Superhuman Guild! High‐quality timber... Ironbark Lumber, freshly cut from the forest!"
The guards atop the watchtowers shifted, rifles glinting in the fading light.
After a moment, the gates opened, and Joe and his companions were allowed to enter.
Inside, the Codebreakers Shelter revealed itself in full...
Joe’s eyes scanned the surroundings.
"Amazing..."
The walls were sturdy, reinforced with steel and timber.
Watchtowers were also present, each manned by defenders armed with rifles or even grenade launchers.
There weren’t any crude bows at all.
Still, field tents dotted the grounds...
There weren’t many children, but the people here looked clean, organized, and well‐fed.
More noticeable was the equipment.
Every defender carried weapons and wore decent gear... armor plates, reinforced clothing, and utility belts. This was no ragtag camp.
There were even motorbikes and some other advanced equipment around.
"This place is thriving..."
Joe’s gaze sharpened further.
At first, he thought the shelter was simply well‐staffed. But as he focused on some of the "men" standing near the perimeter, he noticed something odd.
Their faces were too smooth, their movements were too precise.
"Ahhhh..." He was shocked.
Apparently, beneath the human clothes, faint seams in the exposed "skin" revealed the truth.
Sentinels! They were humanoid robots.
Joe’s lips curled slightly.
’So they’re hiding machines among their ranks... Incredible...’
He could only admire it all. Soon, the cart was pulled into the central yard, where Althea soon arrived.
She carried herself with calm authority, her presence commanding respect.
"Good work," she said, inspecting the lumber. Her hands brushed against the timber, testing its quality.
"Ironbark Lumber... strong, durable. This will serve well for construction."
She gestured, and crates were brought forward.
Inside were canned goods... sardines, meatloaf, and other preserved supplies.
"As agreed," Althea said. "Food in exchange for lumber."
Joe nodded, his four arms moving efficiently as he and his companions loaded the crates onto the cart.
The trade was fair, and the quality of the goods was nothing to question about.
As they prepared to leave, Althea paused.
"You’ve traveled far," she said.
"Rest here for a while. Have a meal before you return. It’s free. We’re not cruel to our partners, especially when the lumber you provide is this valuable."
Joe blinked in surprise...
Hospitality was not something he expected. The Superhuman Guild had started this relationship with conflict, after all.
Yet here, in the Codebreakers Shelter, there was a sense of generosity.
He glanced at his companions.
Their eyes showed their hunger... Despite calling themselves superhuman, their bodies were still weary from the thirty‐kilometer trek...
Finally, Joe nodded his head...
"We’ll accept. Thank you."

chapters.title: Chapter 337: The Golden One
paragraphs: Aurora adjusted the ledger in front of her...
"Everything’s in order..." Aurora muttered. The ink was still fresh from her morning notes.
As the leader of the Provision Division, she had the responsibility to ensure that they had enough food supplies, rationing, and farming experiments.
Her Plant Enthusiast Talent gave her an edge in identifying edible plants and nurturing sprouts, but her responsibilities stretched far beyond the soil.
The kitchen crew worked under her guidance, ensuring meals were prepared before missions and that survivors had the energy to fight.
Today, however, her focus was not on crops or rations. It was at the meeting that had gathered all division leaders in the central hall.

Around the table sat Irene from the Medic Division, Ralph and Claire representing the Assault Divisions Team A and Team B, Victor from Engineering, Wallace from Security, and Russel, who spoke for the Support Units that include drivers, scavengers, scouts, and trapsetters.
Aurora’s eyes focused as Russel finished recounting his memory.

"The herd of bulls... I still remember it," Russel said grimly. "They’re mutated and super strong. Most of them were inedible, like they were poisoned. It’s like the A.I. Army spread a virus to contaminate animals, to make sure humans wouldn’t have enough food."
Aurora tapped her pen against the ledger. "Yes. That’s consistent with what we’ve seen. Normal mutated bulls are toxic. But I heard that the Golden‐Horned Bull is different..."
"Well, the way they described it was like it transcends the corruption. Its horn became mystical, and its meat is not only edible... it enhances Gene development. Is that true?"
"More or less..." Ralph replied.
The room fell silent for a moment.
Victor then thought for a moment before he continued.
"If we capture one, it could help us a lot..."
Wallace knew this as well, but he had to remind them of something...
"But Kai’s orders are clear. The Modified Sentinels stay inside the shelter. They’re defensive assets only. We can’t risk them outside."

Aurora nodded. "Which means we’ll have to rely on manpower. Anyway, we have four Super Soldiers Kai brought from the Auction House. They’re disciplined, equipped, and capable. They should be capable tankers."
Ralph’s eye lit up as he recalled this.
Since the Super Soldiers were being used mostly for construction, he had almost forgotten about them.
"Good. My Team A will support them. Ten of my best, armed with revolvers and rifles. We’ll wear the Advanced Camouflage Gear Set and help them from the back...
Claire nodded. "I guess Team B will remain on standby. If things go wrong, we’ll hurry to your location."
Irene finally spoke. "Then it’s decided. The Super Soldiers will be mobilized. We’ll provide them with some medical kit..."
Later that afternoon, the preparations began.
The four Super Soldiers led by Castor left the armory...
Their heavy armor could deflect three or four shots of Plasma... They also had some other defensive items on them.
Well, they had fought before, but this mission was different.
Althea personally oversaw their outfitting.
First came the Heavy Swords, weapons purchased from the Auction House. Each blade was massive, designed to cut through steel.
The soldiers gripped them with ease, making the weapons feel natural.
Next was the Survival Gear Set. They were from the Superior Survival Gift Pack.
It was equipped with protective plates, utility belts stocked with essentials, and cloaks designed to resist weather.
Each soldier was also given a secondary weapon... an axe. They were compact, but in their hands, these axe were deadly.
Finally, Aurora handed them pouches filled with smoke bombs.
"If you need to escape, use these. Visibility will drop, and you’ll have a chance to retreat."
Draxen nodded. "Understood."
Korval tested the weight of his sword. "We’ll bring the bull down."
Aurora’s gaze lingered on them.They’re strong... but this mission will test them.
Ralph’s Team A assembled next.
Ten men and women, each armed with revolvers and rifles.
Their Advanced Camouflage Gear Set made them appear like shadows, black from head to toe. The gear absorbed light, blending it into the environment.
Ralph addressed his team.
"We’re supporting the Super Soldiers. Our job is to provide cover fire, distract the bull if needed, and ensure no one gets trampled. Stay vigilant... This isn’t a simple hunt."
The team nodded in unison.
By dusk, the hunting party departed.
The forest appeared ahead, and soon, they heard the distant cries of mutated beasts.
Thankfully, the ground was damp from recent rain, so they weren’t easily noticed by the beasts.
Still, the hunt began deep in the forest.
Russel’s scouts had reported sightings of the Golden‐Horned Bull near a clearing, grazing among vegetation. But it wasn’t alone.
A herd of mutated bulls surrounded it... They were also quite massive creatures with darkened hides and eyes wild with corruption.
"It’s here..." Russel whispered, pointing.
At the center of the herd was the Golden‐Horned Bull.
The creature was enormous, its horns were glowing faintly with a golden sheen even in the fading light.
Unlike the corrupted herd, its flesh looked clean, its movements seemed calm... It was as if it was not worrying about any threats...
Castor soon raised his hand, signaling silence.
The Super Soldiers remained low, gripping their heavy swords tightly.
Ralph’s Team A spread out and soon, their rifles aimed at the herd...
But as they were about to begin their operation, the Golden Bull lifted its head with nostrils flaring. It sensed them.
Perhaps, it could sense their killing intent!
"Now," Castor whispered.
Just like that, the Super Soldiers charged.
Their heavy swords swung in arcs, aiming first at the corrupted bulls to clear a path.
Roooarrrr!
The herd exploded in chaos.
The corrupted bulls charged forward with their horns aiming to stab at the humans!
The Golden Bull also roared!
It was so powerful that it created a blast.
Still, they were strong enough to endure this attack!
One of the Super Soldier’s axe struck one of the corrupted beasts, splitting its flank.
Another’s blade then cut across a bull’s shoulder and soon, blood and flesh sprayed into the air. Castor then hurled a smoke bomb, obscuring the battlefield in thick haze.
Soon, Ralph’s team opened fire!
Two corrupted bulls were immediately peppered as they collapsed under the barrage...
However, more of them pressed forward with their hooves, smashing the ground with thunderous force!
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The battle was brutal.
The herd’s strength was immense as its horns were capable of shattering trees.
But the Super Soldiers held their ground. They had obtained this name for a reason! They were humans enhanced with a special Gene!
Castor leapt forward, and soon, his heavy sword pierced the neck of one corrupted bull. The creature collapsed and thrashed violently before going still.
"Focus on the Golden One!" Ralph shouted as he saw the opening...
The Golden Bull roared, charging through the smoke. Its horns glowed brighter as if it was gathering strength!
As they thought that it would just charge with the same speed, something unexpected happened!
The Golden Bull suddenly arrived in front of a Super Soldier!
It happened so quickly that he failed to dodge!
Bam!
Just like that, it smashed into him, sending him sprawling to the ground!
"W-what? Is that a Gene Skill?"
"It can actually use skills like that?"
"Ugh... No one mentioned this!"
"The previous hunt didn’t give the Golden Bull a chance to use its skill."
"Just overwhelm that thing!"
Finally, one of the Super Soldiers intercepted, his axe biting into the beast’s flank.
Castor then swung his sword, and it met the bull’s horn!
Clank!
Ralph’s team then shifted fire, targeting the Golden Bull.
Soon, bullets struck its hide, slowing it, but the creature pressed forward, enraged!
"Push harder!" Ralph shouted.
They didn’t bring Plasma Rifles since they were planning to eat the Bull. Because of that, they had to make some extra efforts to kill it!
The Super Soldiers regrouped.
Soon, the downed Super Soldier drank one of the Stimulants and charged forward once again...
"You’re not going to hit me again!" The Super Soldier shouted.
As soon as he realized that the bull was locked on Castor and that the riflemen weakened the target, he no longer hesitated and stabbed his sword into the Golden Bull’s chest.
Ssaakkk!
The beast cried in pain as golden light erupted from its horns.
It seemed like it was planning to do one last move! However, they wouldn’t let that happen!
The corrupted herd was already in shambles. Most of them had already died, and their roars were also weakening as their leader staggered. No one could stop the Super Soldiers anymore!
"Let’s end this!"

Finally, with a coordinated strike of axes, swords, and gunfire, the Golden‐Horned Bull collapsed. Its golden horns glinted faintly as its life faded! As soon as the Golden Bull died, its herd scattered into the forest.
"It’s done!" Ralph shouted in joy as he asked Renji, one of the temporary members of his team, to use his Appraisal and confirm their hunt.
"Appraisal..." Renji said as he soon got the notification.
[ You have discovered Golden‐Horned Bull Carcass! ]
[ Grade: Rare Resource ]

[ Description: A resilient creature. Flesh is pure and safe for consumption, rich in nutrients. Hide is durable, suitable for crafting protective gear, and the horns contain condensed spiritual energy. ]
[ Note: Meat provides high nutritional value. Horns may be harvested for spiritual enhancement or crafting. ]
