Traceless didn’t know exactly how the skill’s proficiency system worked, but he had already learned that the game seemed to reward actual experience.
Instead of simply waiting around, he decided to practice.
He moved away from the camp and found an open area where he could safely swing his dagger.
At first, he simply performed basic movements.
Then, he gradually increased his speed.
Specter Edge moved through the air repeatedly as Traceless practiced different angles and attack patterns.
He wasn’t trying to learn an entirely new fighting style.
Instead, he was simply trying to become more comfortable with the weapon.
After several minutes, he noticed something.
[ Sword Mastery proficiency has increased. ]
Traceless paused.
’It really works.’
He looked at the notification with interest.
It seemed that the skill could be improved through actual usage, and this meant that he could potentially increase its effectiveness simply by continuing to fight and train.
Satisfied, Traceless continued practicing for a while before finally returning to the camp.
The third day arrived.
By this point, the caravan had already traveled a considerable distance from Reverie Town, and the environment had begun to change.
The forests were becoming denser, but at the same time, there were more signs of civilization along the road.
Old watchtowers could occasionally be seen in the distance, and the roads were wider and better maintained than those around the Beginner Town.
Traceless immediately realized that they were getting close.
’Leonine Town shouldn’t be far now.’
He had heard from Katrina that Leonine was much larger than Reverie Town and served as one of the important settlements near the frontier.
Naturally, he was looking forward to seeing it.
After all, his main reason for accepting the caravan mission was to reach the city and discover what kind of opportunities were available there.
As the caravan continued moving, Traceless stayed near the front, and soon, he realized that he had already spent a lot of time using the Neural Gear!
Farrah and the other members of the Guild must be worried already!

chapters.title: Chapter 348: Last Stretch
paragraphs: After confirming that they weren’t in a tight spot anymore, Kai quickly logged out to check the situation outside.
As soon as he returned to the real world, he immediately learned through Chat, that the situation had changed.

The A.I. Armies had been quite active during the time he was inside Perfect World, and according to the latest reports from the World Chat and Guild Chat, more and more drones had been dispatched to scout the surrounding areas.
Shelters that lacked sufficient defenses were being discovered and destroyed one after another.
Thankfully, the Codebreakers Shelter was still relatively safe.

Claire had also managed to obtain something extremely useful from the Reputation Store. It was an illusion device that could be connected to their Barrier Generator, allowing them to conceal the entire shelter from the perspective of the scouting drones.
Of course, it wasn’t perfect.

If the A.I. Army sent higher-grade detection units to scan the area, the illusion device would eventually be exposed. However, for the time being, it was enough to prevent ordinary scout drones from discovering them.
"I guess leaving the shelter with Claire and Mei is the best decision," Kai muttered after receiving an update on the situation.
He had already expected the A.I. Army to become more active after the destruction of Citadel-09.
The fortress had been an important military installation, and its destruction would naturally cause the machines to become more cautious.
After confirming that the shelter was still safe, Kai asked about the Plasma Cells.
Farrah had already completed the transaction.
All of the Plasma Cells had been sold in exchange for hoverboards.
"Good."
Kai nodded in satisfaction.
The hoverboards would be extremely useful to them, especially if they needed to move quickly through dangerous areas.
As for the remaining loot he had obtained from Citadel-09, Kai decided that there was no reason to keep them in his personal inventory anymore.
Since some time had already passed, he transferred another batch of items to Farrah.
"Farrah... I want you to take care of these items..."
As soon as he said this, he immediately took out the items in his Inventory...
Two hundred Neural Traps, ninety-nine Aetherium Cannon Balls, and ninety-nine C-Grade Cores.
"Use these to strengthen the defenses of the Codebreakers Shelter," Kai instructed.
Farrah looked at the items with a complicated expression.
"You’re really giving all of these?"
"Of course."
Kai didn’t hesitate. He didn’t need money here anyway. Furthermore, with his Infinite Gift Pack Talent, he wouldn’t really starve.
Anyway, Kai explained how the Neural Traps would be particularly useful against humans, especially the mutated ones who couldn’t be reasoned with.
Then, the Aetherium Cannon Balls and C-Grade Cores could be used to strengthen their existing defenses.
He had already obtained more loot than he could immediately use, and he knew that the shelter needed these items more than he did.
After making sure that everything was arranged properly, Kai finally felt relieved.
There was still the matter of returning to Citadel-09, but that could wait.
For now, his first priority was to finish his business in Perfect World... He wanted to obtain more Skill Points through the game!
After all, he needed 8 Gene Skills at Level 7, and he needed 5 of them to be Fused Gene Skills...
As for the Soul Enhancement Serum he must consume, that was basically in the bag already with the 20,000 Credits he had obtained so far. He would trade it later with Cornelio...
"I’ll go back in for a while."
Farrah immediately looked at him.
"Again?"
Kai laughed awkwardly.
"I haven’t finished my mission yet."
"You’ve already been gone for so long!"
"I know."
Kai scratched his head.
"But I should be arriving in the next town soon. I can live my character there for some time."
Farrah sighed.
"Fine. Just don’t forget that you’re still in the real world."
"Don’t worry."
With that, Kai returned to his room. He then placed the Neural Gear over his head once more.
Soon, the familiar sensation of synchronization immediately washed over him.
Whom~
The moment Kai’s vision cleared, his consciousness returned to Perfect World.
He immediately found himself standing beside one of the caravan wagons, exactly where Traceless had been before he logged out.

Kai glanced around the temporary campsite and quickly checked the surroundings. The caravan was still there, with the merchants resting near their wagons while the guards continued taking turns watching over the area.
’I’m back just in time.’

According to the mission details, the caravan was supposed to rest here for a total of six hours before continuing toward Leonine Town. From the looks of things, five hours had already passed while Kai was away dealing with matters in Cameron City.
He had returned before the caravan departed.

If he had waited any longer, he might have missed the final stretch of the journey entirely. The mission probably wouldn’t have failed immediately without him, but Kai had no intention of letting the caravan continue without Traceless after coming this far.
"Alright... Let’s finish this mission."
As he stood beside the wagon, one of the nearby guards suddenly noticed him.
"Traceless? You’re awake."
Kai turned toward him.
"Awake?"
The guard nodded.
"You were resting beside the wagon earlier. I thought you were exhausted from the battles we encountered yesterday."
Kai paused for a moment before giving a casual laugh.
"Yeah. Something like that."

The guard didn’t seem to find anything strange about his answer. After all, Traceless had fought throughout the journey, and there was nothing unusual about an adventurer taking the opportunity to rest during a long caravan trip.
Satisfied, the guard returned to his position.
As expected, exactly one hour later, the caravan began preparing to leave.
The merchants quickly packed away their remaining supplies and secured their belongings inside the wagons, while the guards checked their weapons before taking up their usual positions.
Traceless moved toward the front of the caravan and settled into his usual position.
The journey toward Leonine Town had finally reached its final stretch!

chapters.title: Chapter 349: Leveling Up
paragraphs: At first, the road ahead appeared relatively quiet, but the environment had changed considerably compared to the areas they had passed through earlier in their journey.
Traceless immediately became more cautious as he observed the surroundings... He could tell that they were getting close to the town, but they had to be more careful because of it.
’This looks like a good place for beasts to hide.’
Several minutes passed without anything happening, but then a loud roar suddenly echoed through the forest...
"Roar!"
The caravan immediately came to a halt.
The guards raised their weapons and looked around cautiously, while the merchants began glancing at one another in concern.
"What was that?"
Before anyone could answer, another roar came from the opposite direction.
Then another.
Traceless’s expression slowly became serious as he realized that they were surrounded.
’Several of them.’

He quickly scanned the forest, and soon, the sound of heavy footsteps could be heard approaching from between the trees. The merchants immediately began to panic as a massive creature suddenly emerged from the forest.
It was a huge horned beast covered in thick fur, with two curved horns extending from its head.
[ Level 20 Horned Ironhide Beast ]
’Whoa~ Level 20.’

Before Kai could even consider what to do next, another beast emerged from the opposite side of the road, followed by another one from deeper within the forest. There were several of them, and the situation immediately became dangerous.
The guards quickly formed a defensive line around the wagons.
"Protect the caravan!"
The horned beasts suddenly charged.
The first one crashed directly into the defensive formation, forcing several guards backward from the sheer force of its attack.
Traceless immediately moved forward to help them.
"Don’t fight them alone! Work together!"
As he spoke, he activated Titan Step.

The ground trembled violently beneath his feet as the tremendous force generated by the Gene Skill disrupted the beast’s charge. Its massive body staggered from the sudden impact, giving the guards the opening they needed.
"Attack!"

The guards immediately took advantage of the opportunity. Spears struck against the beast’s thick hide while crossbow bolts flew through the air, forcing the creature to roar angrily as it swung its horns toward the people surrounding it.
These creatures were much stronger than the mutated wolves they had encountered earlier, and a single mistake could easily leave one of the guards seriously injured.
However, Traceless soon realized that the beasts had one major disadvantage compared to the rogue adventurers they had fought on the previous day.
They lacked intelligence.
’They’re powerful, but they don’t know how to work together.’
As long as the guards coordinated properly, they could deal with the beasts one at a time.
"Focus on one!"
The guards immediately concentrated their attacks on the same target, while Traceless summoned Specter Edge and moved forward with them.
Just like that, the guards continued their assault, repeatedly striking the same creature until it finally collapsed.
[ You have defeated a Level 20 Horned Ironhide Beast. ]
[ Experience Points gained. ]
Traceless’s eyes immediately lit up.
’Good.’

There were still several beasts remaining, and the sight of one of their companions falling seemed to enrage the others. The remaining creatures charged toward the caravan together, forcing the guards to tighten their defensive formation around the wagons.

Still, the guards had already learned how to work together, and Traceless had also become familiar with their fighting style. Together, they slowly began bringing down the powerful beasts one after another.
Soon, more and more of them were killed.
[ You have defeated a Level 21 Horned Ironhide Beast. ]
[ You have defeated a Level 20 Horned Ironhide Beast. ]
[ You have defeated a Level 23 Horned Ironhide Beast. ]
[ You have leveled up! ]
As soon as he leveled up, Traceless felt excited.
After all, he already learned that every 3 levels here would give 1 Skill Point!
Thanks to that, he was able to level up his new skills!

The battle continued for several more minutes as the caravan guards fought together while Traceless supported them whenever necessary. Although the Horned Ironhide Beasts were individually stronger than the guards, the caravan had enough manpower to deal with them as long as everyone maintained their formation.
Eventually, the final beast collapsed.
The forest finally became quiet once again.

Traceless looked around the battlefield and saw that the caravan had survived the encounter. A few guards had suffered injuries, but nobody had died, and the merchants were still safe inside the wagons.
Julius soon approached him.
"That was the last danger we should encounter before reaching Leonine."
Traceless raised an eyebrow.
"Should?"
Julius laughed.
"Nothing is ever certain on the frontier."
Traceless couldn’t help but smile at the answer.
That was probably the most appropriate response he could have expected from someone who regularly traveled through dangerous territory.

The caravan soon began gathering the loot left behind by the defeated beasts. Their bodies had disappeared in the usual game-like manner, leaving behind horns, thick hides, meat, and several other materials that could apparently be collected as rewards.
Traceless also received his share of the Experience Points.
He immediately opened his status window.
[ Level: 9 ]
[ Experience: 91% ]
Traceless blinked when he saw the number.
’I’m almost there.’
He only needed a little more Experience Points to reach the next level. Unfortunately, the remaining beasts hadn’t been enough to push him over the threshold, but he wasn’t particularly disappointed.
After all, he had still gained a considerable amount of Experience Points from the battle, and he was now only a short distance away from reaching Level 10.
The caravan eventually resumed its journey.
This time, the remaining trip passed peacefully, and there were no more encounters with dangerous beasts or rogue adventurers.
After another hour of travel, Traceless finally saw the massive walls of Leonine Town appearing in the distance.
His eyes immediately brightened.
’Finally.’
After spending three days on the road, they had finally reached their destination.
The caravan slowly approached the city gates, where the guards inspected the wagons and checked the people traveling with them before finally allowing them to enter.
The moment the caravan passed through the gates of Leonine Town, a familiar notification appeared before Traceless.
[ Mission Complete! ]
[ Mission: Guard Caravan en route to Leonine Town. ]
[ Duration: 3 Days ]
[ Rewards: ]
[ 1,500 Experience Points ]
[ 5 Gold ]
[ Rare Item Chest x1 ]

chapters.title: Chapter 350: For the Skill Point
paragraphs: Traceless stared at the mission completion notification for a few moments before finally looking at the rewards.
The 1,500 Experience Points were already quite attractive...
He was just at 91% Experience Points a while ago, but he was now at 99%, only a short distance away from reaching Level 10...
"Almost there..."
After spending three days traveling with the caravan and fighting several powerful Horned Ironhide Beasts, he felt that this mission had been worth accepting.
However, there was something else that immediately caught his attention.
The Rare Item Chest.
’Let’s see what I can get.’

Traceless immediately opened his inventory and found the chest sitting quietly among his other items. It had a dark metallic appearance with faint blue patterns running across its surface, and although he knew that it was merely an item from a game, the chest still gave him a feeling of anticipation.
After all, this was a Rare Item Chest.
He had no idea what kind of reward could come out of it.
’Please give me something useful.’
Traceless tapped the chest and the moment he did so, the system immediately responded.
[ Rare Item Chest opened! ]
[ Congratulations! ]
[ You have obtained the following rewards: ]
[ Credits x2,000 ]
[ Rare Healing Potion x3 ]
[ Enhanced Strengthening Crystal x1 ]
[ Silverwind Cloak x1 ]
Traceless’s eyes immediately widened.
’Two thousand Credits?’
He was obviously interested in the Credits. After all, Credits were extremely useful in Perfect World, and he could use them to purchase various items through the game’s system.
Furthermore, he could use them in the real world as well!
Of course, the other rewards weren’t bad either.
The Rare Healing Potions were obviously valuable, especially when he considered the dangerous missions he would probably encounter after reaching Leonine Town.
As for the Enhanced Strengthening Crystal, he wasn’t entirely sure what it could do yet, but the description immediately appeared when he focused on the item.
[ Enhanced Strengthening Crystal ]
[ Description: A special crystal that can be used to strengthen eligible equipment or items. The success rate and effects depend on the quality of the target item. ]
’Interesting.’
Traceless immediately became more interested.
He didn’t have many items that could apparently be strengthened, but he would definitely find a use for it eventually.
Finally, there was the Silverwind Cloak.
[ Silverwind Cloak ]
[ Type: Rare Equipment ]
[ Description: A lightweight cloak created from the fur of a Silverwind Beast. Increases movement speed by 5% and reduces the sound produced by the wearer’s movements. ]
Traceless couldn’t help but smile.
’This is actually quite useful.’

The effect wasn’t overwhelmingly powerful, but it suited his fighting style. Increased movement speed was always valuable, while reducing the sound of his movements could help him when moving around quietly.
It could potentially complement his stealth abilities as well.
’Not bad at all.’
Traceless kept the items in his inventory aside from the cloak and looked around Leonine Town.
The city was clearly different from Reverie Town.
Even after arriving through the main gate, he could already see countless adventurers moving through the streets.
Indeed, this was no longer a beginner town.
He could guess that there were more players around, and many of them were wearing equipment that was obviously better than the novice sets he had seen back in the Beginner Town.
The shops were also much larger, while the buildings were constructed with more durable materials.
This place truly felt like a settlement meant for adventurers who were already beginning to leave the safety of the starting areas.
’So this is Leonine Town.’
Traceless looked around with interest.
Katrina had mentioned that this place would have more opportunities, and after seeing the city for himself, he understood what she meant.
If he wanted to obtain better missions and stronger rewards, this was probably the right place to start.
With that thought in mind, Traceless immediately headed toward the Adventurers’ Guild.
The Adventurers’ Guild of Leonine Town was considerably larger than the one in the beginner Town.

The moment Traceless entered, he saw dozens of adventurers gathering around the mission board. Some were discussing their next expedition, while others were returning from missions and exchanging their rewards.
There were also several reception counters where adventurers could register missions and submit their completed requests.
Traceless immediately walked toward the mission board.
He wasn’t particularly interested in simple gathering missions anymore.
After all, his current strength was already considerably higher than that of an ordinary beginner player.
He wanted missions that would provide better rewards.
More importantly, he wanted to find missions that could give him something that he couldn’t easily obtain through ordinary hunting.
As he scanned the mission board, Traceless’s eyes suddenly stopped.
’What is this?’
One of the missions had a reward that immediately caught his attention.
[ Mission: Noble Child’s Sparring Partner ]

[ Mission Description: A noble family is currently seeking a capable adventurer to serve as a sparring partner for their young heir. The selected adventurer must be capable of fighting against the young noble without causing serious injury while providing appropriate combat pressure and guidance. ]
[ Duration: 5 Days ]
[ Requirement: Minimum Level 8 ]
[ Daily Requirement: 4 Hours of Sparring ]
[ Reward: 1 Skill Point, 800 Experience Points, 30 Credits ]
Traceless stared at the reward.
’Huh? One Skill Point? That’s possible?’
His expression immediately changed.
He had only recently discovered that Skill Points could be obtained through leveling up, and they were incredibly valuable because they could directly improve his Gene Skills.
However, this mission was offering an entire Skill Point as a reward.
Naturally, he was interested.
’And I only need to spar for four hours a day?’
Traceless wasn’t worried about the difficulty either.
He had already fought against Level 20+ Horned Ironhide Beasts and survived battles against rogue adventurers.
Sparring against a noble child for four hours a day was unlikely to be difficult.
At worst, he would have to restrain himself.
’This should be easy.’
He immediately accepted the mission.
[ Mission Accepted! ]
[ You have accepted the mission: Noble Young Master’s Sparring Partner. ]
[ Additional Information Unlocked. ]
[ Target: Cedric Whitemon. ]
[ Residence: Whitemon Residence, Eastern District of Leonine Town. ]
[ Family Status: Third Son of House Whitemon. ]
[ Combat Level: Beginner to Intermediate. ]
[ Preferred Weapons: Short Sword and Training Spear. ]
[ Personality: Competitive, impatient, and highly ambitious. ]
[ Mission Schedule: 5 Consecutive Days. ]
[ Required Training: 4 Hours per Day. ]
[ Important: The target has a tendency to become reckless when losing. The assigned adventurer must prevent serious injuries while allowing the target to experience genuine combat pressure. ]
Traceless nodded.
’As expected.’
He wasn’t concerned about the restrictions.
In fact, he was rather interested in seeing how strong the noble child was.
’If he’s talented, this could actually be interesting.’
However, just as he was about to search for another mission, something else caught his attention.
It was another mission with a Skill Point as part of its reward.
Traceless’s eyes immediately narrowed.
’Another one?’
He quickly opened the mission details.
[ Mission: Poison Resistance Tester ]
"Eh?" Traceless paused for a moment as it felt a bit too difficult. Still, he considered it carefully.

[ Mission Description: A researcher requires a resilient adventurer to participate in a series of controlled poison resistance tests. The participant will be administered several different poisons over the duration of the mission while medical personnel monitor the subject’s condition. ]
[ Duration: 7 Days ]
[ Minimum Requirement: Level 8 ]
[ Required Tests: At least 3 Poison Tests ]
[ Reward: 1 Skill Point, 1,200 Experience Points, 50 Credits ]
Traceless stared at the mission.
’Poison tester?’

The mission immediately sounded difficult. Even if the description specifically stated that the poisons were being administered under controlled conditions, there was still a reason why they needed an adventurer to test them.
Poisons were not something that could be taken lightly.
However, Traceless soon began thinking about his own abilities.
He had Bio-Adaptive Constitution, Great Protection, Blood Regeneration, and he also possessed the Guardian title.
All of these abilities provided him with considerably greater survivability than an ordinary player.

With so many Gene Enhancements, his body was more resistant to harmful effects, his regeneration was stronger, and his overall resilience was already considerably higher than what his Level 9 status would normally suggest.
’If I had to choose someone to test poison, I would probably choose myself.’
Traceless couldn’t help but smile.
Of course, he wasn’t foolish enough to assume that he was completely immune to poison.
His abilities had limits.
There were also different types of poison, and some might be specifically designed to bypass certain forms of resistance.
However, the mission description clearly stated that the poisons were controlled and that antidotes would be provided.
There was still a risk, but the mission was obviously designed to be survivable.
At least, that was what Traceless assumed...
"Fine... For the skill point!"

[ Required Poison Tests: Minimum 3 ]
[ Testing Schedule: Determined by the assigned researcher. ]
[ Medical Support: Antidotes and emergency treatment will be provided. ]
[ Important Notice: The provided antidotes are not guaranteed to completely neutralize the effects of every poison. ]

The 1,500 Experience Points were already quite attractive...
He was just at 91% Experience Points a while ago, but he was now at 99%, only a short distance away from reaching Level 10...
"Almost there..."
After spending three days traveling with the caravan and fighting several powerful Horned Ironhide Beasts, he felt that this mission had been worth accepting.
However, there was something else that immediately caught his attention.
The Rare Item Chest.
’Let’s see what I can get.’
Traceless immediately opened his inventory and found the chest sitting quietly among his other items.
It had a dark metallic appearance with faint blue patterns running across its surface, and although he knew that it was merely an item from a game, the chest still gave him a feeling of anticipation.
After all, this was a Rare Item Chest.
He had no idea what kind of reward could come out of it.
’Please give me something useful.’
Traceless tapped the chest and the moment he did so, the system immediately responded.
[ Rare Item Chest opened! ]
[ Congratulations! ]
[ You have obtained the following rewards: ]
[ Credits x2,000 ]
[ Rare Healing Potion x3 ]
[ Enhanced Strengthening Crystal x1 ]
[ Silverwind Cloak x1 ]
Traceless’s eyes immediately widened.
’Two thousand Credits?’
He was obviously interested in the Credits.
After all, Credits were extremely useful in Perfect World, and he could use them to purchase various items through the game’s system.
Furthermore, he could use them in the real world as well!
Of course, the other rewards weren’t bad either.
The Rare Healing Potions were obviously valuable, especially when he considered the dangerous missions he would probably encounter after reaching Leonine Town.
As for the Enhanced Strengthening Crystal, he wasn’t entirely sure what it could do yet, but the description immediately appeared when he focused on the item.
[ Enhanced Strengthening Crystal ]
[ Description: A special crystal that can be used to strengthen eligible equipment or items.
The success rate and effects depend on the quality of the target item. ]
’Interesting.’
Traceless immediately became more interested.
He didn’t have many items that could apparently be strengthened, but he would definitely find a use for it eventually.
Finally, there was the Silverwind Cloak.
[ Silverwind Cloak ]
[ Type: Rare Equipment ]
[ Description: A lightweight cloak created from the fur of a Silverwind Beast.
Increases movement speed by 5% and reduces the sound produced by the wearer’s movements. ]
Traceless couldn’t help but smile.
’This is actually quite useful.’
The effect wasn’t overwhelmingly powerful, but it suited his fighting style.
Increased movement speed was always valuable, while reducing the sound of his movements could help him when moving around quietly.
It could potentially complement his stealth abilities as well.
’Not bad at all.’
Traceless kept the items in his inventory aside from the cloak and looked around Leonine Town.
The city was clearly different from Reverie Town.
Even after arriving through the main gate, he could already see countless adventurers moving through the streets.
Indeed, this was no longer a beginner town.
He could guess that there were more players around, and many of them were wearing equipment that was obviously better than the novice sets he had seen back in the Beginner Town.
The shops were also much larger, while the buildings were constructed with more durable materials.
This place truly felt like a settlement meant for adventurers who were already beginning to leave the safety of the starting areas.
’So this is Leonine Town.’
Traceless looked around with interest.
Katrina had mentioned that this place would have more opportunities, and after seeing the city for himself, he understood what she meant.
If he wanted to obtain better missions and stronger rewards, this was probably the right place to start.
With that thought in mind, Traceless immediately headed toward the Adventurers’ Guild.
The Adventurers’ Guild of Leonine Town was considerably larger than the one in the beginner Town.
The moment Traceless entered, he saw dozens of adventurers gathering around the mission board.
Some were discussing their next expedition, while others were returning from missions and exchanging their rewards.
There were also several reception counters where adventurers could register missions and submit their completed requests.
Traceless immediately walked toward the mission board.
He wasn’t particularly interested in simple gathering missions anymore.
After all, his current strength was already considerably higher than that of an ordinary beginner player.
He wanted missions that would provide better rewards.
More importantly, he wanted to find missions that could give him something that he couldn’t easily obtain through ordinary hunting.
As he scanned the mission board, Traceless’s eyes suddenly stopped.
’What is this?’
One of the missions had a reward that immediately caught his attention.
[ Mission: Noble Child’s Sparring Partner ]
[ Mission Description: A noble family is currently seeking a capable adventurer to serve as a sparring partner for their young heir.
The selected adventurer must be capable of fighting against the young noble without causing serious injury while providing appropriate combat pressure and guidance. ]
[ Duration: 5 Days ]
[ Requirement: Minimum Level 8 ]
[ Daily Requirement: 4 Hours of Sparring ]
[ Reward: 1 Skill Point, 800 Experience Points, 30 Credits ]
Traceless stared at the reward.
’Huh?
One Skill Point?
That’s possible?’
His expression immediately changed.
He had only recently discovered that Skill Points could be obtained through leveling up, and they were incredibly valuable because they could directly improve his Gene Skills.
However, this mission was offering an entire Skill Point as a reward.
Naturally, he was interested.
’And I only need to spar for four hours a day?’
Traceless wasn’t worried about the difficulty either.
He had already fought against Level 20+ Horned Ironhide Beasts and survived battles against rogue adventurers.
Sparring against a noble child for four hours a day was unlikely to be difficult.
At worst, he would have to restrain himself.
’This should be easy.’
He immediately accepted the mission.
